meta.name: pop-up-book-illustration
meta.description: 生成3D纸艺弹出书风格插画，具备立体层次感、明亮温暖色调，适用于科技、教育、品牌展示等场景

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成3D纸艺弹出书风格插画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中加入立体纸艺风格的视觉元素
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add 3D papercraft style visuals to your projects

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按3D纸艺弹出书风格生成插画：画面有立体层次、纸质纹理、打开的书本场景，配色固定为薄荷绿、天蓝、珊瑚橙、奶油黄等明亮暖色，并可加入科技元素作点缀。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成具有纸艺质感、立体层次、特定明亮暖色调的插画时触发。

say.text: 给我画一张科技主题的弹出书插画
say.note: 会生成含科技元素的立体纸艺画面

say.text: 用弹出书风格画教育主题的知识树
say.note: 得到多层知识树与暖色纸质质感插图

say.text: 做个品牌展示的弹出书，用薄荷绿和珊瑚橙
say.note: 产品元素会从书页中弹出，配色按要求

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will generate illustrations in a 3D paper-art pop-up book style: layered depth, paper texture, an open book scene, bright warm colors (mint, sky blue, coral, cream), optionally accented with tech elements.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for illustrations with paper-craft texture, layered depth, or the specified bright warm color palette.

say_en.text: Create a tech-themed pop-up book illustration for me.
say_en.note: Produces a layered paper-art scene with tech elements.

say_en.text: Draw an educational knowledge tree in pop-up book style.
say_en.note: Results in a multi-layer tree with warm paper textures.

say_en.text: Make a brand showcase pop-up book in mint and coral.
say_en.note: The product pops out of the pages with the chosen palette.
